week_overview: Hey there! Week 1 is shaping up to be pretty intriguing, especially with running backs stealing the spotlight—lots of anytime touchdown props are showing strong edges. Jahmyr Gibbs and Derrick Henry are at the top of the list this week, both with serious value in finding the end zone. Javonte Williams also has a strong edge you might want to look into. However, it’s worth noting there aren’t any high-confidence plays or arbitrage opportunities popping up this week, which makes it feel a bit tighter. Overall, it feels like a solid week to dip your toes into the prop bets, but keep an eye on those running backs dominating the landscape!

games.summary: In this matchup, I’m really intrigued by the receiving props, especially for Jaxon Smith-Njigba. On the flip side, I’m leaning toward the rushing yards being worth a look, too, particularly since there are some solid overs in that department. Just keep in mind that while Smith-Njigba’s TD bet feels pretty solid, the rushing props could be a bit risky depending on game flow, so maybe keep those stakes lighter.

On the other hand, the unders on passing touchdowns and receiving yards have me a bit wary.
